title: WaterColor 100 Flatwood Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Access to WaterColor amenities and community pools*- Located in the beautiful Crossings II community of WaterColor- Private pool *Pool can be heated for an additional $35/day during the winter months* - 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 adult bikes provided- Ping pong table- Fire pit- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Recharge with a sunny Gulf escape at 100 Flatwood Street! Tucked within WaterColor, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom property comfortably sleeps 12 between the Main and Carriage Houses. A premier 30A community, WaterColor guests enjoy access to multiple pools, a lazy river, biking trails, and more—including the Beach Club, only a 12-minute walk away. Picture carefree afternoons sunbathing beside the private pool or playing ping-pong on the porch, and charmed evenings toasting marshmallows around the firepit!An idyllic coastal cottage, the 3-level Main House welcomes guests into an open great room, wrapped in shiplap walls and dotted with wicker and driftwood accents. Settle on the soft slip-covered couch and armchairs to watch TV or relax with loved ones. Quartz counters and top-of-the-line appliances await in the gourmet kitchen, complete with a vast center island that doubles as a breakfast bar with 4 stools. Directly across is the wooden dining table for 10, boasting banquette seating beneath a recessed window. Step outside to recline on the porch swing or meander down to the courtyard and sip lemonade on the cushioned woven furniture beside the rippling pool. Off the back porch, a brick-paved patio surrounded by southern magnolias, pines, and palmettos hosts a gas grill and firepit.Venture to the second level and discover an elegant retreat in the primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and furnished porch. This floor includes a laundry room, a porch with a ping-pong table, and 2 guest bedrooms, with a queen and a king bed, respectively.The third level is ideal for families with a spacious bedroom hosting 2 queen beds, a kid-friendly hangout space equipped with beanbag chairs and a TV, and a cozy balcony for enjoying the fresh air.Guests will love the private Carriage House, boasting a kitchenette, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed, as well as access to the pool deck.Experience a wonderful WaterColor getaway at 100 Flatwood Street. On-site parking, 5 complimentary bikes, a low-speed vehicle, and the community trolley make it easy to explore. Guests can use 2 beach access points—the first is at the WaterColor Beach Club, and the second is on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12):SECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Additional Sleeping Area : 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.

Tucked within WaterColor, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom property comfortably sleeps 12 between the Main and Carriage Houses. Guests will love the private Carriage House, boasting a kitchenette, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed, as well as access to the pool deck. Experience a wonderful WaterColor getaway at 100 Flatwood Street. On-site parking, 5 complimentary bikes, a low-speed vehicle, and the community trolley make it easy to explore. Guests can use 2 beach access points—the first is at the WaterColor Beach Club, and the second is on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!
